summary: A Bornhuetter Ferguson ultimate is no longer rounded to a whole number, so a DFM or Berquist-Sherman adjustment reading a BF vector now matches ResQ.
details: The New Ultimate column keeps the same six decimals as every other BF vector; ResQ never rounds it.
A claim-count BF feeding a Berquist-Sherman settlement-rate adjustment had moved the adjusted paid triangle's earliest ages by up to 2% from ResQ.
A BF method saved before this fix keeps its whole-number ultimates until it is saved or refreshed again.
